None states a birth date.
Candidate's own pages: robbonta.com and robbonta.com/about; 2026 general Official Voter Information Guide (no candidate statement from Bonta). No birth date stated.

News search: The FilAm column (2021-05-19) and an Asian Journal column state September 22, 1972, but Wikipedia (reference work) cites an October 1971 newspaper notice of a September 22, 1971 birth and April 2021 reports giving his age as 49. The year conflicts and no official or contemporaneous record could be opened here, so no date is recorded.

citations.quote: Born in Quezon City, Philippines, Bonta immigrated to California with his family as an infant.

Prior to serving in the Assembly, Attorney General Bonta worked as a Deputy City Attorney for the City and County of San Francisco, where he represented the City and County and its workers, and fought to protect Californians from exploitation.
Bonta served nine years as a Deputy City Attorney in the San Francisco City Attorney’s Office, representing the city and its employees, before running for local office in Alameda County.
Before that he worked in private practice, where he protected Californians from racial profiling.
After law school, Bonta moved back to California and went into private practice, working pro-bono to protect Californians from exploitation and racial profiling.
Bonta grew up and attended public school in California before working his way through Yale University and earning his Juris Doctor from Yale Law School.
He graduated Cum Laude with a bachelor’s degree in history in 1993.
Bonta grew up and attended public school in California before working his way through Yale University and earning his Juris Doctor from Yale Law School.
He returned to enroll at Yale Law School – again with the help of financial aid — and graduated with a Juris Doctor degree in 1998.
Rob Bonta is using his role as Attorney General of the State of California to make life better for everyone in the Golden State.
Rob Bonta* Democratic California Attorney General
